t: L-PRO Extra Large Knitted Cloths are highly absorbent cleaning cloths designed for efficient washing, wiping, and general cleaning tasks. These durable dishcloths are ideal for busy workshops, kitchens or general site clean-ups, effectively tackling spills and grime. Each cloth measures 30cm x 50cm, offering extensive coverage. The double-sided, tubular design provides a thick feel and enhanced absorbency, while hemmed edges prevent fraying for prolonged use. Supplied in a convenient 20-pack, these machine washable cloths are built for repeated use, ensuring long-lasting performance and hygiene.
b: Highly Absorbent & Efficient for Spills & Cleaning
